name: {brand.display_name}
_notes: Schema.org has no dedicated environmental-testing subtype, so this vertical emits ProfessionalService (a LocalBusiness subtype) as primary with additionalType HomeInspector — the closest recognized subtype for inspection-shaped businesses and the type mold/asbestos inspection firms commonly carry in Google's ecosystem. Do NOT emit any restoration/remediation business type: the client is an independent tester.

brand.hours_specification is resolved from brand.hours at build time. Emit an around-the-clock OpeningHoursSpecification ONLY when brand.hours actually says 24/7; otherwise emit the brand's real business hours. Environmental testing clients are almost never 24/7.
